manifest.label: feasible-pose-v1
manifest.policy: Complete clocks and task-object poses preserved; compare geometrically symmetric jaw signs, retain every IK failure. No collision or dynamics success inferred.

pad_calibration.axis_evidence: Pinned URDF arm_tip fixed transform: translation [0,0,0.10], rotation Rx(pi) from palm.
pad_calibration.method: Area-weighted inward collision-face centers, 0.95 cosine threshold; fixed nominal aperture.
pad_calibration.scope: CAD surface proxy, not calibrated deformable pad contact; sampled variation is not a continuous bound.

physical_limitations: No robot/scene or self-collision admission
No actuator tracking or contact verification
Arm velocity, acceleration and torque feasibility not enforced
No inferred neck target

left.axis_evidence: Pinned Robotiq 2F85 pinch site lies on gripper +Z; native pad separation is -Y.
left.source_contact_semantics: Documented grip/pinch site proxy; no measured contact patch is asserted

right.axis_evidence: Pinned Robotiq 2F85 pinch site lies on gripper +Z; native pad separation is -Y.
right.source_contact_semantics: Documented grip/pinch site proxy; no measured contact patch is asserted

source_mapping.clock: actual native mjData.time, post-action state; unchanged through IK

left.resampling: none; original consumed source action row retained
left.semantics: derived desired joint target; not issued control, measured aperture, or contact label
